name: Notion

auth.keyHelp: Create an internal connection (workspace owner), copy its token, then share each page or database with it from the page's menu under Connections.

tested: mock; real service refused a fake key
notes: Notion-Version 2026-03-11 is what the current reference pages list (the versioning page's 'latest' placeholder was unfilled; 2025-09-03 and 2026-03-11 have upgrade guides). Databases are queried through data sources (POST /v1/data_sources/{id}/query); the search filter value is 'page' or 'data_source'. Pages must be shared with an internal connection or calls fail. The authentication page lists three token kinds: internal connections (bot identity), personal access tokens (act as the creating user, created in the Developer portal), and public OAuth connections. NOT confirmed: the token prefix, and whether a connection can be made read-only (capabilities exist, but the pages read do not spell out a read-only setting). The body details of GET /v1/pages/{page_id} were truncated in the page read; the path is the standard pattern. POST /v1/pages with an internal connection needs a page or data-source parent. Official MCP server https://mcp.notion.com/mcp is OAuth-interactive; Business/Enterprise workspace owners can create MCP tokens in the Developer portal for use as a bearer token; integration tokens are not documented as accepted by the hosted server.
